Green Corridors is a deeply thoughtful work, and an expertly crafted production.
Green Corridors is a play meant for the 21st century audience — not simply because of its subject matter, but because of its insistence on urgency and responsibility.

cn.t: Ukrainian playwright Vorozhbyt's urgent drama of displacement earns strong reviews for its uncompromising portrayal of refugee experiences, with precise staging evoking constant instability through wheeled doorways and threshold imagery.
